component.name: Fylz
component.summary: A legible file manager with an archive viewer and an operation journal

description.p: Fylz browses folders and looks inside archives (zip, tar, 7z and more) without extracting them. Every change it makes is recorded in an on-disk journal so an interrupted operation can be reconciled instead of silently half-done.
This desktop build is an early shell shared with the Ubuntu Touch app. It is read-only for now: there is no copy, move, delete or rename UI yet.
